## Description

Trains score-based generative diffusion models on macroeconomic leading indicator panels to synthesize infinite macroeconomic scenario paths for stress testing systematic macro funds.

## Where it may fit

Macro fund stress testing, tactical asset allocation scenario generation, monetary policy shock simulations.

## Vehicles

Global Macro Hedge Funds, Quantitative Risk Management Groups.

## Required data

Historical macroeconomic indicator series (CPI, PMI, interest rate curves, employment prints).

## Caveats

Reverse diffusion sampling requires numerical ODE solvers, increasing scenario generation time.
